title: [BUG] Claude doesn't follow instructions in ./claude/instructions/*.md
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [X ] Anthropic API
  - [ ] AWS Bedrock
  - [ ] Google Vertex AI
  - [ ] Other: 
- Claude CLI version: Claude Code v1.0.77
- Operating System: Windows10
- Terminal:  powershell

## Bug Description
Created instructions telling claude to communicate impersonally with minimal verbage.
Start claude. Claude communicates as if the instructions does not exist.

[communication.md](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21804542/communication.md)
[conversation.md](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21804543/conversation.md)

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Add instructions mds telling it not to talk a certain way when performing tasks.
2. Restart claude.
3. Give claude a task to perform.

## Expected Behavior
"CHECKING: ...", no step by step explanations

## Actual Behavior
"Now I need to ...", "Great!", "Let me..."
